The image focuses on the upper tips of the fungal branches, which are cylindrical and terminate in rounded, slightly flattened ends. A thin, dark, out-of-focus twig or debris crosses the foreground diagonally. The background is a soft, blurred green and brown bokeh, indicating a forest floor environment.
